name: Convai
tagline: Conversational AI characters and NPCs for games and virtual worlds.
description: Convai is a developer platform for building lifelike, voice-driven non-player characters and virtual humans. Its SDKs for Unity, Unreal Engine, PlayCanvas, and the web add end-to-end speech, LLM reasoning, long-term memory, perception, and action execution so characters can hold natural conversations, understand their surroundings, and perform in-world tasks. Studios use it to ship interactive NPCs across games, XR, and the open web.
insight: Its conversational-NPC tech was showcased in NVIDIA's ACE technology demos for AI-driven game characters.

modelSupport.notes: Bundles speech (ASR/TTS) with pluggable LLM reasoning for embodied characters.

edge: Purpose-built for embodied 3D NPCs — perception, in-world actions, and lip-sync — beyond text-only character chatbots.
